Channels and account management
Basic includes email support only. Team adds live chat from the Northwind console, and Enterprise adds a dedicated phone line and a shared Slack channel with our on-call engineers.
Each Enterprise account has a named technical account manager who holds a review call every quarter, covering usage, incidents and upcoming product changes. query: How long are backups kept on the Enterprise plan?
top1_first_lines:
kept for 365 days; Team backups for 90 days; Basic for 30 days. Backups are taken automatically and stored in a second region that is at least 400 kilometres from the primary one.
Basic databases are backed up once a day, Team databases every 12 hours and Enterprise databases every 6 hours. Team and Enterprise customers can also restore a database to any second within the retention window, using point-in-time restore.
Northwind restores a random sample of backups every week to confirm that they can be read. Failed restore tests open an internal incident, and customers affected by a failed test are notified within 24 hours.
Deleted resources and closed accounts
A deleted resource can be recovered for 7 days on Basic, 14 days on Team and 30 days on Enterprise. After that period the resource can only be rebuilt from a backup.
